header.description: Spells explorer lookups: FindNegates, the arrays the list and pane menus build for it, LookUpSpellCast
notes: FindNegates and LookUpSpellCast are MME's own procedures cut from frmMain.frm; the progress bar is a no-op and the Results window is a recording ListView (frmResults.lvResults). Rows are read as [Text, Tag, cells].

The menu cases run mnuSpellsPopUpItem_Click(5) and mnuAuxPopUpItem_Click(5) with objWorkingListView standing for the selected row; the call to FindNegates is preceded by a copy of its three arguments (gNegSpells, gNegAbils, gNegLevel).
InputBox answers are the case's "inputbox" list (an empty answer is Cancel).

data.items is [number, name, in game, [negated spells], [ability, value ...]]; data.spells is [number, name, learnable, length of Casted By, 1-based position of 'item #' in it (0 none), MinBase, MaxBase, MinInc, MaxInc, MinIncLVLs, MaxIncLVLs, Dur, DurInc, DurIncLVLs, Cap, ReqLevel, [ability, value ...]].
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra).
